This '''Twi'lek mother''' and her [[Unidentified Twi'lek child (hostage)/Legends|child]] were captured as hostages at a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] train station by [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]], a thief of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], while she was being chased by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was freed when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] disarmed Cryar and knocked her unconscious.
